description: All-in-one package of Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable runtimes for x86 and x64, including legacy and current runtime packages.
notes: Review status: standalone manifest created separately from vcredist-aio.json. The official v0.106.0 ZIP publishes the SHA-256 digest recorded above.

The upstream README instructs users to extract the package and run Installer.cmd as administrator. Its installer checks for and removes existing non-compliant Visual C++ runtimes before installing the bundled runtimes.

This staged manifest only downloads and extracts the ZIP. It does not execute Installer.cmd or any runtime installer. The archive payload and exact script path have not been inspected; verify the contents and install/uninstall behavior before promotion to bucket/.
